Jules Verne, Michael Strogoff, translated by W. H. G. Kingston.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/jules-verne/michael-strogoff/w-h-g-kingston

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Jules Verne, the author, died 1905 (Wikidata Q33977, P570 = 1905-03-24).
- W. H. G. Kingston, the translator, died 1880 (Wikidata Q32829, P570 = 1880-08-05).

First publication of the text used: 1876 (SE colophon: 'Michael Strogoff was published in 1876 by Jules Verne. It was translated from French in 1876 by W. H. G. Kingston.'). The country of this translation's first publication is not stated in the facts.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1876, before 1931, so the United States public domain applies to it.
- Country of origin: the last person to die, Jules Verne, died in 1905. Every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever the country of first publication.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
